note: FAILURE spec: what a stopped D1 search still owes. Nothing is `required`, deliberately -- an early failure may legitimately have produced none of it, and demanding an artifact on the failure path would block the collection of what the run DOES have. The driver writes `d1_search.json` on every path out, so there is normally something here even when stage A refused.
patterns_are_relative_to: the collector's --root, which SessionRunner sets to <checkout>/artifacts. See the success spec for what a doubled `artifacts/` prefix cost.
